g.text: Global product frontend components - all pending implementation
safe Markdown for Assistant and plan
safe JSON or plain text for tools
isolated event drafts and current question index
Adapters selected explicitly; no Runtime fallback.
Freeze request intent, not mutable authority.
Server rechecks state for every mutation.
Completed events and preview are separate.
No credentials or internal Session IDs.
Plan, approval and progress have separate authority.
One current pending kind / target is derived from events.
Question, plan review and permission are mutually exclusive.
All views and Slash share submission and recovery admission.
